adjudication.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts, the code persists new attendees via prisma.booking.update(... attendees.createMany ...) before calling eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking). That updateCalendarAttendees call is not inside a try/catch (only sendAddGuestsEmails is), and there is no DB transaction/rollback around the sequence. If updateCalendarAttendees throws (plausible since it likely performs external calendar updates), the mutation will error after the DB has already been updated, leaving DB attendees changed while the external calendar may not be updated—an inconsistency introduced by this diff.
